description: The chart depicts the effect of context masking on case tasks, with results grouped by language family and shown for six model/configuration variants. The horizontal axis contains the categorical language-family groups ordered left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “effect,” shown on a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 10, 20, and 30 (and the plotted range extending slightly below 0 and up to the mid-30s). Within each language-family group, six adjacent bars are displayed in a consistent left-to-right color/legend order: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red), each with vertical error bars. Approximate bar heights by group are: IE-Baltic shows small positive effects (light blue ~2, dark blue ~1, light green ~3, dark green ~3–4, pink ~6, red ~5); IE-Germanic shows mid-range values for L₂ (~10 for both blues), near-zero to slightly negative values for R₂ (greens around 0 to about −1), and higher values for B₂ (pink and red both ~15); IE-Indic shows the largest bars overall with L₂ near 0 (light blue ~1, dark blue ~0), R₂ high (light green ~20, dark green ~18), and B₂ higher still (pink ~24, red ~21); IE-Romance shows moderate positives (light blue ~6, dark blue ~4, light green ~5, dark green ~1, pink ~12–13, red ~6); IE-Slavic shows L₂ around ~10 (light blue) and ~9 (dark blue), R₂ near ~1 (light green) and ~0 (dark green), and B₂ around ~17 (pink) and ~15–16 (red); IE-other shows L₂ around ~6 for both blues, R₂ near 0 (greens around ~0 to ~1), and B₂ around ~8 for both pink and red; Isolate shows values clustered near 0 to ~2 (light blue slightly below 0, dark blue near 0, greens around ~1–2, pink and red around ~1–2); Semitic shows larger positive bars for L₂ (light blue ~11, dark blue ~16), negative R₂ bars (light green ~−2, dark green ~−1), and higher B₂ bars (pink ~15, red ~19–20); Uralic shows small values near ~0–2 across all six bars (light blue ~1, dark blue ~1, light green ~1, dark green ~0.5–1, pink ~2, red ~1). The bars are not visually sorted by magnitude within groups; instead they follow the fixed legend order, and no individual bars appear specially highlighted beyond the consistent color coding and the presence of error bars.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks grouped by language family. The horizontal axis displays categories labeled as language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, arranged sequentially from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled 'effect' and ranges from 0 to 40, with intervals of 5 units. Each category contains six bars representing different models or configurations: mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂, colored light blue, dark blue, light green, dark green, pink, and red, respectively. Notably, the Semitic group shows the highest variability, with error bars spanning from approximately -10 to 25, while the IE-Indic group consistently exhibits the largest effect values, peaking at around 30. In contrast, the Uralic group demonstrates the lowest effect values, with all bars below 5. The IE-Germanic group shows a steady increase across configurations, while the IE-Baltic group displays a slight decline in effect values across models. Error bars indicate the standard deviation, highlighting variability within each language family and model configuration.
